title: Analytics
intro: How your searches are doing: speed, conversion between steps, results by source, and how many positions each recruiter carries. Only positions you can see are counted.

timeToFill.label: Time to fill
timeToFill.formula: Median days from the position's first move to sourcing until an offer was accepted, for positions with an accepted offer in this period.

timeToInterview.label: Time to interview
timeToInterview.formula: Median days from submission to the first interview, for first interviews in this period.

outreachResponse.label: Outreach response rate
outreachResponse.formula: Candidates who answered (interested, not interested, not now or referred someone) ÷ candidates first contacted in this period.

submissionToInterview.label: Submission to interview
submissionToInterview.formula: Candidates interviewed ÷ candidates submitted in this period.

interviewToOffer.label: Interview to offer
interviewToOffer.formula: Candidates who got an offer ÷ candidates first interviewed in this period.

offerAcceptance.label: Offer acceptance rate
offerAcceptance.formula: Offers accepted ÷ offers made in this period.

interviewToHire.label: Interview to hire
interviewToHire.formula: Candidates who started ÷ candidates first interviewed in this period. A hire counts when the person starts.

sourceToHire.label: Source to hire
sourceToHire.formula: Candidates who started ÷ candidates added to a position in this period.

conversion.heading: Conversion between steps
conversion.caption: Share of candidates who reached each step and went on to the next

sources.heading: Results by source
sources.caption: Candidates added in this period, by where they were found
sources.empty: No candidates were added in this period.

capacity.heading: Capacity
capacity.perRecruiter: Positions being worked per recruiter, on average
capacity.timePerPosition: Days from sourcing to filled, per filled position (median)
capacity.caption: Positions each recruiter carried and filled in this period
capacity.empty: No positions were being worked in this period.

cohortNote: Rates follow a group of candidates: a candidate counts when the starting step happened in the period, and counts as converted if they reached the next step at any time since.
